query: Can I get my money back for a laptop I bought last week?
passages: Laptop money-saving tips: buy last year's model when the new laptops arrive in stores.
A laptop bought last week is covered by the two-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
Get a laptop bag with padding; money spent on protection saves repairs later.
Our laptops are built from recycled aluminium and shipped in plastic-free boxes.
Payment for a laptop is possible by card, invoice or in four instalments.
Customers may send an unused device back within 30 days of delivery and receive a full refund.
Last week's laptop sale ended on Sunday; new offers start every Monday.

query: Which network port must be open for the database?
passages: Open the network settings of the web interface to change the port of the proxy.
The database port is shown in the status bar of the admin console.
A network outage on the database host stops all services until it is back.
Services reach PostgreSQL on TCP 5432; firewalls between them must allow that.
Database ports below 1024 need root rights and are not recommended.
Network traffic between modules is encrypted when TLS is enabled.

query: Who may remove a team from the platform?
passages: Teams can be removed from a document's sharing list by anyone who owns the document.
A platform has teams, users and documents as its main entities.
Who may see a team's documents depends on membership.
Removing a user from a team does not delete the documents they shared.
Only an owner of the team can delete it, and platform admins can delete every team.
Teams appear in the sidebar under the heading Teams.

query: My answer stopped halfway, is it lost?
passages: An answer halfway through the sources may cite the same document twice.
Lost documents can be found again by searching for part of their title.
A stopped or interrupted answer is saved up to the last word and marked as stopped, so nothing is lost.
Answers are generated by the model chosen in the conversation header.
The stop button ends a running answer immediately.
If the connection to the model is lost, the answer is marked as failed.

query: How do I change the encryption keys of the login service?
passages: The login service is reachable at the address shown on the sign-in page.
Keys for tokens are rotated by adding a new signing key, waiting until old tokens expire, and then removing the old one.
Documents are not encrypted by the platform itself; use disk encryption on the server.
Change your password at the login service, not in the platform.
Encryption in transit is provided by the proxy with a TLS certificate.
Login attempts are limited to ten per minute and address.

query: Is there a size limit when I add a file?
passages: Adding a file to a conversation limits answers to that document.
Files you add are private until you share them with a team.
The size of the context window limits how many passages fit into a prompt.
Supported file types are PDF, Word, Markdown and plain text.
Uploads above 50 MB are rejected, so split very large files before adding them.
Added files are split into passages of about 300 words.

query: Why do I get no hits when I search for something that is in my files?
passages: Search hits are highlighted in the document preview.
Files that are in the trash do not appear anywhere.
You find files by their title in the document list.
Documents show up in search only after indexing has finished; a file still being processed has no hits yet.
Hits are sorted by relevance and show the matching passage.
Search is case insensitive and ignores punctuation.

query: Does it run on a machine without a graphics card?
passages: The machine learning models run in the model server, which is optional.

Yes, small models such as llama3.2 work on a CPU; answers are slower but everything else is the same.

The stack needs Docker and about 8 GB of free memory.
Run the stack on a server or on your own machine.

query: Can I take a conversation with me to another tool?
passages: Conversations are kept on the server and never leave your installation.

Export a conversation as Markdown or JSON from its menu to use it elsewhere.
Rename a conversation by clicking its title.

query: How up to date are the numbers on the usage page?
passages: Usage numbers cover the last 30 days unless you pick a longer range.
The usage page is only visible to signed-in users.
Numbers of tokens may differ from the invoice of the model provider.
The figures are refreshed hourly, so a new generation appears at the next refresh.
The page shows usage per day, model and module.
Page layout and numbers follow the language of your browser.

query: Will the assistant quote a document that is no longer valid?
passages: Archived and deprecated documents are never cited; answers use only current documents.
Documents that are no longer valid can be marked as deprecated by their owner.
The assistant quotes sources as numbered links below the answer.
A valid document has a title, a body and an owner.
Quote a passage in your question to make the assistant look for it.
Documents can be restored from the archive at any time.

query: What to do when the AI vendor says too many requests?
passages: Vendors of AI models are configured in the llm module settings.
Too many requests at once are rejected by the platform itself, at most eight in parallel.
Requests to the platform are logged with a trace id.
What to do first: check the provider health on the models page.
The assistant can be asked to repeat an answer with the regenerate button.
A provider that rejects calls for exceeding its limit causes a rate limit message; wait a minute and ask again, or raise the quota with the vendor.
